mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near its current depressed level while TRANSIT remains below -25%, weekday destination traffic stays weak and RETAIL_REC will edge lower over the next four weeks versus the prior four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -25.0 at t-0w and TRANSIT was -27.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -20 and TRANSIT remains below -20 for at least three of the four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM toward less-negative values signals more errand-based out-of-home activity, which spills into adjacent retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -5.0 after a week below -5.0
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -6.0 at t-1w to -5.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 1-2 weeks after GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -5.0 and remains there for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS drops sharply from an elevated week and stays near zero or negative, it indicates weaker discretionary outing intensity; that reduction spills into retail-and-recreation demand over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week from a positive reading
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 15.7 at t-1w to 2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS falls more than 10 points from a positive level and remains near zero or below for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES move together in the same direction, they jointly track commuting intensity; simultaneous weakness in both should translate into lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks, while simultaneous recovery should lift it.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both deeply negative in all four weeks
failure_condition: Changes in RETAIL_REC do not align with joint moves in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES over the next 2 weeks, especially when both series weaken together.

mechanism_narrative: A stable or rising RESIDENTIAL index alongside weak TRANSIT implies more time spent at home and fewer incidental shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should remain below its recent average over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive while TRANSIT stayed below -25 across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 0 and TRANSIT remaining below -25 for most of the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp recovery in WORKPLACES after a trough typically precedes more lunch and after-work shopping; if WORKPLACES improves by at least five points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC should rise within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by 5 points or more week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -31.0 at t-1w to -25.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week after WORKPLACES rises by at least 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: In an outdoor-activity regime, a positive PARKS shock combined with stagnant TRANSIT diverts discretionary time away from indoor retail toward parks, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds 10 while TRANSIT stays below -20
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was 15.7 at t-1w and TRANSIT remained below -20 throughout
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS stays above 10 and TRANSIT stays below -20 for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps improving while RETAIL_REC remains below -20, consumers are substituting necessary errands for discretionary shopping; that substitution should keep RETAIL_REC flat to lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC stays below -20
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -7.1 at t-3w to -5.3 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC stayed below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -20 within two weeks despite GROCERY_PHARM rising for two consecutive weeks and remaining above its prior 4-week average.
